summary.text: Lucy Rehm, listed by Ballotpedia as Lucille Rehm, is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 48B, in office since January 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Caleb Steffenhagen. She is a former educator and Chanhassen City Council member.

paragraphs.text: Lucy Rehm lives in Chanhassen, Minnesota.
She earned a B.A. in English from the College of Saint Benedict & Saint John's University, and Ballotpedia says her career includes work as an educator.
Rehm served on the Chanhassen City Council and the Chanhassen Environmental Commission.
She defeated incumbent Greg Boe in the November 8, 2022, general election for District 48B and defeated Caleb Steffenhagen on November 5, 2024.

For 2025-2026 she serves on the Education Finance and Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy committees and is co-vice chair of the House Transportation Finance and Policy Committee.
